NOTE:  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION INFORMATION
  Agenda reports and other disclosable public records relating to each Open Session agenda item are
  available on the City's web site under City Council Meeting agendas at www.RollingHillsEstates.gov and
  during regular business hours in the office of the City Clerk. Meetings are live broadcast on the City's web
  site and a recording is available for viewing after each meeting. Meetings are also broadcast on PVP -TV
  Channel 35 (Cox) and Channel 39 (Verizon).

  Public Comment is welcome on any item during City Council consideration of the item. An opportunity is
  also provided for the public to comment on non-agenda items concerning City matters. If you would like to
  address the City Council regarding an item on this agenda or make a general public comment, please
  complete a speaker sheet and give to the City Clerk.

MINUTES
  CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  JANUARY 27, 2026

1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

MAYOR STEGURA called the meeting to order at 7:03 p.m.

2.  SALUTE TO THE FLAG

Led by Palos Verdes Peninsula Village Board President, Monique Sugimoto and
Communications Chair Judy Bayer.

3.  ROLL CALL

City Council Members Present:  Brown Schachter, Huff, Schmitz, Stegura, Zerunyan

City Council Members Absent:  None

City Staff Present:  City Manager Greg Grammer
  City Attorney Don Davis
  Assistant City Manager Alexa Davis
  Administrative Services Director Mike Whitehead
  Community Dev/Public Works Director Jeannie Naughton
  City Clerk Lauren Pettit
  Assistant to the City Manager Jessica Slawson
  Public Works Manager Kirsten Graham
  Senior Accountant Fernando Estrada
  Administrative Aide Gabrielle Swain

4.  CEREMONIAL ITEMS

A.  PROCLAMATION: DECLARING JANUARY 27, 2026, AS INTERNATIONAL
  HOLOCAUST REMEMBRANCE DAY

MAYOR STEGURA declared January 27, 2026 as International Holocaust Remembrance
Day.

B.  PROCLAMATION: DECLARING FEBRUARY 2026 AS AMERICAN HEART MONTH

MAYOR STEGURA declared February 2026 as American Heart Month.

C.  PROCLAMATION: DECLARING FEBRUARY 2026 AS BLACK HISTORY MONTH

MAYOR STEGURA declared February 2026 as Black History Month.

5.  CONSENT CALENDAR

The following routine matters will be acted upon by one vote to approve with the majority consent of the City
Council. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless good cause is shown by a member prior to the
roll call vote. (Items removed will be considered under New Business.)

  COUNCIL MEMBER SCHMITZ moved, seconded by MAYOR PRO TEM
  SCHACHTER, TO APPROVE CONSENT CALENDAR ITEMS 5A-F AS FOLLOWS
  BY THE FOLLOWING ROLL CALL VOTE:

  AYES:  Brown Schachter, Huff, Schmitz, Stegura, Zerunyan
  ABSENT:  None

A.  READING OF ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS

  APPROVED.

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  1
JANUARY 27, 2026
 B.  DEMANDS AND WARRANTS OF DECEMBER 2025 & JANUARY 2026

  APPROVED WARRANTS 69163 THROUGH 69285 IN THE AMOUNT OF
  $1,902,201.22 AND SUPPLEMENTAL WARRANTS 120425 THROUGH
  120625; 010126 THROUGH 011226; IN THE AMOUNT OF $483,709.99 FOR
  A GRAND TOTAL AMOUNT OF $2,385,911.21 WITH PROPER AUDIT.

C.  SCHEDULE OF INVESTMENTS REPORT OF DECEMBER 2025

  RECEIVED AND FILE.

  RECEIVED AND FILE.

  RECEIVED AND FILED.

F.  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES OF JANUARY 13, 2026

  REVIEWED AND APPROVED.

6.  CITY COUNCIL REORGANIZATION

A.  PRESENTATION TO OUTGOING MAYOR DEBBY STEGURA & NOMINATION OF
  NEW MAYOR

COUNCIL MEMBER ZERUNYAN thanked and recognized MAYOR STEGURA by
highlighting her many accomplishments as Mayor over the last year.

COUNCIL MEMBER ZERUNYAN presented MAYOR STEGURA with gifts including a
commemorative photo book from her year as Mayor, and a mayoral gavel plaque.

COUNCIL MEMBER ZERUNYAN introduced those in attendance to make presentations to
MAYOR STEGURA:

  •  Rohan Abraham, representative from Congressman Ted Lieu’s office
  •  Edward Feves, representative from Senator Ben Allen’s office
  •  Cody Bridge, representative from Assemblymember Al Muratsuchi’s office
  •  Jennifer LaMarque, representative from Los Angeles County Board of Supervisor
  Janice Hahn’s office
  •  Ian May, representative from the Los Angeles County Assessor’s Office
  •  Mayor Seo, Mayor Pro Tem Perestam, and Council Member Bradley, Rancho Palos
  Verdes
  •  Mayor Dieringer, Rolling Hills
  •  Council Member Lozzi, Palos Verdes Estates (not present but remarks read aloud)
  •  Palos Verdes Library District Board President, Jonathan Beutler and Trustees Rosa
  Kwon Easton and Beth Whittenbury
  •  Palos Verdes Peninsula Unified School District Board President Sara Deen
  •  Los Angeles County Sheriff Captain Kimberly Guerrero
  •  Palos Verdes Peninsula Chamber of Commerce Vice President, Karin Conklin

COUNCIL MEMBER ZERUNYAN indicated that recognition for MAYOR STEGURA was
also received from the Los Angeles County Fire Department.

MAYOR STEGURA thanked all the dignitaries, her fellow Council Members and City staff,
and commented on her year as Mayor.

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  2
JANUARY 27, 2026
 MAYOR STEGURA nominated COUNCIL MEMBER ZERUNYAN to serve as the City’s next
Mayor.

  FRANK ZERUNYAN APPOINTED MAYOR BY ACCLAMATION.

MAYOR ZERUNYAN provided a brief presentation on the history of the City of Rolling Hills
Estates, including becoming the third in the City’s history to serve five terms as Mayor.

  ***
:

At 8:44 p.m. MAYOR ZERUNYAN adjourned the meeting to a brief reception.

MAYOR ZERUNYAN called the meeting back to order at 9:00 p.m.

  ***

7.  PUBLIC COMMENT/PUBLIC PRESENTATIONS

None.

7.  PUBLIC HEARINGS

None.

8.  NEW BUSINESS

A.  ANNUAL COMPREHENSIVE FINANCIAL REPORT FOR FISCAL YEAR ENDED
  JUNE 30, 2025ANNUAL COMPREHENSIVE FINANCIAL REPORT FOR FISCAL
  YEAR ENDED JUNE 30, 2025

  Recommendation: That the City Council of the City of Rolling Hills Estates receive
  and file Annual Comprehensive Financial Report (ACFR) for fiscal year ended June
  30, 2025.

Senior Accountant Estrada provided a staff report (as per the agenda material), and
introduced Senior Accountant Devin Feldhut from Rogers, Anderson, Malody & Scott, LLP who
presented the Annual Comprehensive Financial Report.

Public comment was invited in-person in the Council Chamber, via email and via eComment.
No public testimony was received.

  COUNCIL MEMBER STEGURA moved, seconded by COUNCIL MEMBER HUFF,
  TO APPROVE AS FOLLOWS BY THE FOLLOWING ROLL CALL VOTE:

  RECEIVED AND FILED ANNUAL COMPREHENSIVE FINANCIAL REPORT
  (ACFR) FOR FISCAL YEAR ENDED JUNE 30, 2025..

  AYES:  Brown Schachter, Huff, Schmitz, Stegura, Zerunyan
  ABSENT:  None

14.  ADJOURNMENT

MAYOR ZERUNYAN adjourned the meeting in memory of Jade C. Brownlee, Lomita Sheriff
Station Clerk who passed away. The meeting was adjourned to Tuesday, February 10, 2026
at 7:00 p.m. for the purpose of a regular meeting.
